rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for both a scientific hypothesis and an assumption made for an argument.

example.english: For now, our hypothesis is that the bus will arrive on time, so we can make it.
example.traditional: 我哋先假設條巴士準時到，咁就趕得切喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sin1 gaa2 cit3 tiu4 baa1 si2 zeon2 si4 dou3 gam3 zau6 gon2 dak1 cit3 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a scientific or theoretical hypothesis that can be tested.

example.english: This hypothesis still needs to be tested through experiments.
example.traditional: 呢個假說仲要靠實驗去驗證。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 gaa2 syut3 zung6 jiu3 kaau3 sat6 jim6 heoi3 jim6 zing3

rows.note: Use this for an assumption accepted as true temporarily for reasoning or investigation.

example.english: For this analysis, we make the hypothesis that all the data are accurate.
example.traditional: 喺呢個分析入面，我哋假定所有數據都準確。
example.jyutping: hai2 ni1 go3 fan1 sik1 jap6 min6 ngo5 dei6 gaa2 ding6 so2 jau5 sou3 geoi3 dou1 zeon2 kok3
